references.text: Jesus raises a little girl from the dead by taking her by the hand and saying 'Get up!', which resembles the action and words used in Mark 5:41.
Jesus raises a young man from the dead by touching his bier and speaking directly to him, demonstrating his power over death, similar to what is seen in Mark 5:41.
Jesus raises Jairus' daughter by taking her by the hand and commanding her to get up, parallel to the event in Mark 5:41.
Moses stretches out his hand over the sea to part it, showing an act of divine intervention through physical action, similar to how Jesus uses his hand in Mark 5:41.
Elisha raises a dead boy by lying on him and praying, demonstrating God's power to give life, parallel to Jesus' action in Mark 5:41.
